content.text:
**Finding: deviation (§ 3.2 Renewal, p0040)** — validated redline submitted.

- **Renewal term:** auto-renews for a term "equal in duration to the previous term," so a multi-year initial term rolls into another multi-year term — a walk-away item under the rule. Fixed at successive 12-month terms.
- **Notice window:** 90 days exceeds both the preferred (30) and fallback (60) limits. Shortened to 30 days.
- **Reminder / pricing:** no renewal reminder and no uplift cap anywhere (§ 4.1 leaves Charges entirely to the Service Option Attachments/Order Forms). Added a 60-day IBM renewal notice and capped renewal Charges at the lesser of CPI and 3%, with 60 days/5% flagged in the comment as our fallback.
